metric.name: Engineering Friction
metric.purpose: Where engineering time is lost: a team-level index of flow friction.
metric.formula: friction = round(min(100, 10*wip_limit_breaches + 6*review_queue_depth + 4*(oldest_in_progress_age_sec/86400.0))); WIP is context, not scored

inputs.note: WIP shown as context, not scored

metric.caveats: v1 placeholder over current flow signals; not yet wait-time decomposition across the correlated flow graph. Team-level only — never individual.
metric.gamingRisks: Splitting work items to lower WIP, or closing review threads without real review, can understate friction; read alongside throughput and cycle time.
